लञ्ज,
 I. m.
 1. A foot.
 2. The end of the lower garment, tucked into the waistband.
 3. A tail.
 II. f. जा.
 1. An adulteress.
 2. Lakṣmī.
 3. Sleep. See the next.

लञ्जिका, i. e. लञ्जा + क. f. A harlot.
 --Cf. perhaps λάγνος.

लाञ्छ् (akin to लक्ष्; cf. लछ्), i. 1, Par. †
 1. To mark.
 2. To dress, Vikr. d. 53.

लाञ्छ् + अन, n.
 1. A mark, Pañc. iii. d. 204.
 2. A name, Utt.

(श्रि-कण्ठ-पद-, adj. Having as surname the word Śrikaṇṭha.) []
